shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo "-----"; ls -la /home/sandbox/workspace; echo "-----"; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md; echo "-----"; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat index.html; echo "-----"; ls -R src; echo "-----"; for f in src/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo "-----"; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; echo "-----"; ls __agent_eval__ .claude; echo "----- routing top"; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo "----- traps"; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo "----- node/npm"; node -v; npm -v; ls node_modules | head -50

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "----- version"; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version"; echo "----- peers"; node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').peerDependencies)"; echo "----- docs"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null || ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null || echo "no local docs"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && echo "----- INDEX head"; sed -n 1,80p build/docs/INDEX.md; echo "----- README required setup"; rg -n -i -C 12 "required setup|getting started|styles.css|fonts.css|Provider" README.md | head -120; echo "----- components list"; ls build/docs/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo "----- peer optional?"; node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').peerDependenciesMeta)"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && echo "----- controls"; ls components/controls; echo "----- Provider (theming guide)"; rg -n -C 6 "Provider" guides/theming.md | head -90; echo "----- INDEX Provider mentions"; rg -n -C 3 "Provider" INDEX.md | sed -n 1,60p

echo "===== TextInput props"; rg -n -A 40 "^## Properties|^## Props" components/controls/TextInput.md | head -70; echo; echo "===== PasswordInput props"; rg -n -A 30 "^## Properties|^## Props" components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -50; echo; echo "===== Checkbox props"; rg -n -A 25 "^## Properties|^## Props" components/Checkbox.md | head -40; echo; echo "===== Button props"; rg -n -A 30 "^## Properties|^## Props" components/Button.md | head -45; echo; echo "===== Card props"; rg -n -A 25 "^## Properties|^## Props" components/Card.md | head -35; echo; echo "===== Text props"; rg -n -A 25 "^## Properties|^## Props" components/Text.md | head -35

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && echo "===== PasswordInput.md"; cat build/docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -120; echo; echo "===== Flex in layout guide"; rg -n -B 2 -A 30 "^## Flex|^### Flex" build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -80; echo; echo "===== Card view/type values"; rg -n -A 8 "^## View|^### View|outlined|filled|raised" build/docs/components/Card.md | head -40; echo; echo "===== Text.d.ts"; cat build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "===== Flex.d.ts"; cat build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120

echo "===== Box.d.ts"; cat build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -80; echo "===== layout types.d.ts (gap/spacing)"; rg -n -C 3 "gap|Space|spacing|LayoutComponentProps" build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts | head -90; echo "===== layout guide: spacing section"; rg -n -B 2 -A 25 "^## Spacing|^## Box" build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -110; echo "===== migration-layout-v8 removed spacing"; rg -n -C 4 "spacing" build/docs/guides/migration-layout-v8.md | head -60; echo "===== ButtonView"; rg -n "ButtonView" -A 6 build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -30; echo "===== Card size"; rg -n "size" build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts

echo "===== Button view type"; rg -n "ButtonView\s*=" -A 3 build/esm/components/Button/*.d.ts | head -20; echo "===== Card.d.ts"; cat build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -60; echo "===== Checkbox.d.ts"; cat build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -40; echo "===== Provider.d.ts"; cat build/esm/components/Provider/Provider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40 || rg -n "ProviderProps" build/esm/components/**/*.d.ts | head

echo "===== BUTTON_VIEWS"; rg -n "BUTTON_VIEWS" -A 4 build/esm/components/Button/constants.d.ts build/esm/components/Button/constants.js 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "===== Provider location"; rg -l "ProviderProps" build/esm/components/**/*.d.ts build/esm/components/*/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "===== Provider index export"; rg -n "Provider" build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head; echo "===== Card accepts padding? (BoxProps -> BaseStyleProps)"; rg -n "BaseStyleProps" -A 3 build/esm/components/layout/hooks/useStyleProps.d.ts | head -12

echo "===== Provider.d.ts"; cat build/esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts; echo "===== theme index exports"; cat build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; echo "===== root index exports theme?"; rg -n "theme" build/esm/components/index.d.ts build/esm/index.d.ts | head; echo "===== Text variants"; rg -n "TextVariant\s*=|TEXT_VARIANTS|'header-1'" build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts build/esm/components/Text/text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo "===== Text colors"; rg -n "ColorTextBaseProps|color\?" -A 2 build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -12

npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "----- Card.css padding"; rg -n "padding" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.css | head; echo "----- Text.css margin reset"; rg -n "margin" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "----- styles.css h1 reset?"; rg -n "h1|margin" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -5
